remarks: Charming Rowayton Townhouse -- Nestled in the heart of Rowayton, this fully renovated townhouse offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and coastal village charm. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, the home is thoughtfully designed with wide-plank floors, abundant storage, and inviting living spaces. Enjoy mornings on the covered front porch with views of the Five Mile River, or entertain outdoors on the private back terrace surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens. Just steps from town, marinas, shops, and restaurants, this home offers unmatched convenience and walkability. Available beginning October for a 12-18 month lease, this property presents a rare opportunity to experience in-town Rowayton living at its finest.
